title: Hearty Egyptian Lamb Skillet
description: A flavorful Egyptian dish featuring lamb, digestive biscuits, and a blend of spices, perfect for a brunch gathering, with a grassy and cheese-pull twist, and a low-carb friendly option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, and red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add 1/4 cup of water to the skillet and bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the crushed digestive biscuits and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Top the lamb mixture with crumbly feta cheese and serve hot.
